title: expectrail.repro-bench/v1
description: The public reproduction bench: defects of one game, each a patch against the clean game and a bug report written as a player would write it. Read by expectrail.repro.bench. It holds no result: results are records made from runs.

path.description: A file in this repository under bench/ or bugs/, never a held-out path.

game.description: The clean game every patch applies to.

family.description: The defect families of issue #282, section 3.

patch.description: The defect, a unified diff against the game (-p1).

report.description: The bug report, a text file in a player's words.

origin.description: reported: a reproduction of a publicly reported bug (bugs/reported/). written-for-bench: written by the team for this bench.

authorExpects.description: Where the author expects the defect to show: in the engine's record, only on screen, or both. A label written before any run, not a measurement.

tunedOn.description: True when probes or signals were designed while looking at this defect, so reproducing it shows less.
